summary: Frontend-only validation of new Wedding Chip (Page 1) + Invitation Hero (Page 2) flow on desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844). All required data-testids present. 3D chip renders and reaches data-ready=true, tap-to-begin visible, body overflow hidden pre-reveal. Tapping chip-open-btn triggers chip-status, lid open, morph, then invitation-hero mounts; body becomes scrollable (overflow: hidden auto). Page 2 reveals inv-ganesha, inv-shloka (|| SHREE GANESHAAY NAMAH ||), inv-names (Sanidhya & Vasudha), inv-subtitle (An Integrated Circuit of Love), inv-quote, inv-heartchip. chip-replay-btn appears during opening/morphing phases and successfully resets scene to closed/tap-to-begin on click. Downstream formal-invitation-section renders after reveal. Music control (data-testid='music-toggle-btn') visible. Zero console errors and zero WebGL errors on both viewports.
action_items: Review-request mentioned data-testid='floating-nav' and 'play-music' but implementation uses 'nav-menu-btn' / 'music-toggle-btn'. Not a bug (elements exist and work) — only a naming mismatch vs. the request text. Optionally add aliases if automation elsewhere depends on those exact ids.

Note: chip-replay-btn is intentionally unmounted together with WeddingIntro after reveal (AnimatePresence exit in App.js). It is only available during opening/morphing/done inside the intro, which matches the stated 'developer replay' purpose.
critical_code_review_comments: Clean phase state machine in WeddingIntro (closed→activating→opening→morphing→done) with timers cleared on replay — good.
ChipCanvas provides a non-WebGL fallback; main flow uses Three.js and reached data-ready reliably.
App.js correctly unmounts WeddingIntro via AnimatePresence after onComplete, preventing stale 3D canvas from eating pointer events behind main content.
Minor: a Lenis warning 'container should have non-static position' appears once — cosmetic, not an error.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full tap→open→morph→reveal flow verified on desktop and mobile with 0 console/WebGL errors. Replay button only exists while WeddingIntro is mounted (phases opening/morphing/done); after reveal it is unmounted by design. Horizontal overflow on InvitationHero is clean at 390px (sw==cw==390). Pre-existing overflow in FormalInvitation marquee/floral-arch was out of scope per request and not tested.
